description: This file defines an enumeration `MenuItemHighlightColors` that provides color logic for menu item Highlights in a macOS application. It includes a nested `Palette` struct and functions to obtain primary and secondary highlight colors based on a highlighted state, often used in UI rendering.

methods.name: primary(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Color
methods.description: Returns the primary highlight color, adjusted based on whether the item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Color
methods.description: Returns the secondary highlight color, with opacity adjustment when highlighted.

methods.name: palette(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Palette
methods.description: Constructs a color palette with primary and secondary colors based on the highlighted state.
